Advances: ancora.parsing

Stage: L3 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Parser (port, unchanged block grammar), Ancora.Schema.* (surgery: drop realized_by schema; Verification.kind accept-and-warn as format/retired_construct; execute: optional-tolerated; garbage kind is spec/parse_error), Ancora.Index (port, no realization inputs), Ancora.DecisionParser (port; change_type/supersedes/replaces/reverses_what parsed-and-ignored), Ancora.DecisionParser.Affects (keep affects_empty and affects_unresolved only). Retired constructs tolerated on both diff sides; HEAD-side presence emits format/retired_construct. NOTICE entries for each ported module. Ancora.Parser.parse_file/2 and Ancora.DecisionParser.parse_file/2 documented as the semver-stable API (README text lands in L12; the commitment is recorded in moduledocs here).

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.parsing.block_grammar_unchanged, retired_constructs_tolerated, adr_grammar, stable_public_api, consumer_corpora_parse
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.parsing.scenario.specled_spec_parses_identically, retired_construct_pair, retired_construct_on_head, garbage_kind_is_parse_error, adr_with_change_type_is_silent, adr_missing_consequences, consumer_fixture_parses (one sanitized real spec file per consumer as a fixture)
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from specled_ex; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: parse_file/2 consumed by Index here and by Atlas SpecDoc after M9; proving test is the ported parser suite
  - Fixture hygiene: spec fixtures under test/fixtures/specs, no compiled fixtures
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each retired construct branch, each ADR section branch)
- Call-site Integration: Ancora.Parser.parse_file/2 and Ancora.DecisionParser.parse_file/2 are the future stable public API (Atlas runtime consumer after M9). Proving test now: the ported parser suite and the consumer fixture test.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/{verifier,tag_scanner,tag_findings,append_only,overlap,policy_files}.ex (L4)
- lib/ancora/derive/**, lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/output*, lib/mix/tasks/**
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora.ex (facade index/2 only), lib/ancora/parser.ex, lib/ancora/schema.ex, lib/ancora/schema/**, lib/ancora/index.ex, lib/ancora/decision_parser.ex, lib/ancora/decision_parser/affects.ex
- test/ancora/{parser,schema,index,decision_parser}*_test.exs, test/fixtures/specs/**, test/support/**
- NOTICE
- .spec/specs/ancora.parsing.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no change to the block grammar; no new block kinds
- no cross_field rules beyond affects_empty/affects_unresolved
- no tag scanning or structural verifier here (L4)

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
